area_measurement_disagreement.interpretation: The score compares nominal vector area with rasterized visible contribution. It is not an occlusion fraction and does not prove occlusion.

position_descriptor_audit.analytic_descriptor: 3x3 bin of nominal analytic filled-area centroid (bbox center fallback)
position_descriptor_audit.interpretation: Descriptor disagreement is measurement disagreement only. This audit does not establish whether occlusion caused it.
